highlights: Mandatory child protection training for staff
Criminal background checks and confidential references for new employees
State-of-the-art air filtration systems in all classrooms
Strict guidelines for parents and visitors accessing the school campus
safety.policy_summary: ISB is committed to a culture of exceptional care and safeguarding, ensuring a safe and supportive environment free from harm, abuse, and neglect. All staff undergo mandatory child protection training upon employment and annually, pass criminal background checks, and adhere to strict visitor and access control guidelines.
